install.notes: The card's install block. The fake backend and the acceptance gate need none of the upstream dependencies: fake.py is pure Python. The upstream package requires Python 3.10.*, MuJoCo 3.11.0, gymnasium > 0.29.1, numpy 1.26.4, torch 2.7.0 and gear_sonic (pyproject.toml:8-22); the README asks for Linux x86_64 with an NVIDIA GPU and EGL headless rendering (README.md:20-28). The sim backend was not run.
